report.title: UKSI taxon names for tanhub
report.description: A list of UKSI taxon names for tanhub.
report.query: -- Return names for all accepted taxa in the configured groups and their hierarchy. WITH all_ttlids AS ( SELECT DISTINCT cttl.id FROM cache_taxa_taxon_lists cttlc JOIN cache_taxon_paths ctp ON ctp.taxon_meaning_id=cttlc.taxon_meaning_id JOIN cache_taxa_taxon_lists cttl ON cttl.taxon_meaning_id=ANY(ctp.path) AND cttl.taxon_list_id=#taxon_list_id# AND cttl.preferred=true AND cttl.allow_data_entry=true WHERE cttlc.taxon_list_id=#taxon_list_id# AND cttlc.allow_data_entry=true #filters# ) SELECT #columns# FROM cache_taxa_Taxon_lists cttl WHERE cttl.preferred_taxa_taxon_list_id IN (SELECT id FROM all_ttlids) AND cttl.allow_data_entry=true AND cttl.taxon_list_id=#taxon_list_id#

param.name: taxon_list_id
param.description: ID of the taxon list to load taxa for.

param.name: taxon_group_ids
param.description: Optional taxon groups of the taxa to load, comma separated IDs.
